name: Poker DEALER button — white acrylic puck with DEALER face label
description: The canonical dealer button: a chunky white acrylic puck (Ø76 × 20 mm) with a readable 'DEALER' label on the face and a faint recessed face ring. In-scene the same puck is recoloured blue/yellow + relabelled SB/BB for the blind markers.

parts.name: Faint recessed face ring
parts.note: Subtle light-grey inner face disc on top, reads the moulded recess the DEALER text sits in.

parts.name: DEALER face label
parts.note: Readable 'DEALER' label on the face (dark plate + light lettering; real buttons engrave black-on-white — inverse, still reads). axis y = faces up.

needs: Thickness 20 mm = chunky casino-puck look (sourced 19–22 mm); flat discs are ~6 mm
DEALER is a dark plate decal (light text) — real buttons are black-on-white engraving; engraving font/depth unsourced
Black O-ring edge bumpers not modelled; DEALER on the bottom face omitted (player sees the top)
SB/BB markers are the same puck recoloured (blue/yellow) + relabelled in-scene — not separate modelgen specs
